summary: Expanded the universe around defense sub-tier manufacturing capacity with one reference prime and three lower-attention suppliers. The strongest underfollowed candidates are not necessarily the largest weapons primes; they sit in specialty chemicals, aerospace/defense contract manufacturing, and defense electronics where qualification, backlog, tooling, and program history can become schedule-setting bottlenecks.
